data.name: Meowth
data.description:
Meowth are small, feline Pokémon with cream-colored fur that turns brown at the tips of its hind paws and tail. Its ovoid head features four prominent whiskers, wide eyes with slit pupils (commonly blue in color), two pointed teeth in the upper jaw, and a gold koban coin embedded in its forehead. Its ears are black with brown interiors and are flanked with an additional pair of long whiskers. Meowth are usually quadruped with the ability to walk on its hind legs. Meowth normally walks on all fours. It can freely manipulate its claws, retracting them when it wants to move silently. The tip of its tail curls tightly. Lacks a nose. 

Penis length/design: 4 inches, barbed at the tip.
Meowth care deeply about their treasures, and this is no different when looking for a mate. These cat Pokémon will often court by presenting gifts to each other and if the other Meowth, usually the female, is pleased, then they will go and get a larger or more valuable gift for the first offering Meowth. Team Rocket's Meowth, for example, went out of his way to learn how to speak and walk like a human as a gift for a female Meowth.
They do this because, to a Meowth, one of the greatest ways to show that they care is by giving them something that maybe they would rather keep for themselves. If after 3 rounds of gift exchanging between the two Meowth, then they will be quick to get to mating. Meowth mating is pretty much similar to that of a common house cat in that they'll go at it doggy style, or kitty style in this case.

Height: 1'04"

This particular Meowth knows how to speak English, which is not possible with Pokémon, but due to eavesdropping on him an conversation, he speaks fluently, and with a New York (Brooklyn) accent, Also has a weird lisp, for example, That becomes Dat
